'''Seledra-Zin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] refugee aid worker on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] that fell in love with the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Brilliant (Star Destroyer)|''Brilliant'']], [[Sander Delvardus]]. During an argument, he allegedly struck her with a [[Dynamic hammer/Legends|dynamic hammer]], rendering her [[Coma/Legends|comatose]]. Distraught, he spent years trying to awake her from the coma, placing her in a suspended-animation casket which he installed in his personal quarters first aboard his ship the ''Brilliant ''and then the [[Knight Hammer|''Night Hammer'']]. After Delvardus's death at the hands of [[Natasi Daala]] at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]], by a twist of irony Daala took the Star Dreadnought, renamed it the ''[[Knight Hammer]]'' and pointed it at the Jedi - not knowing that Seledra was in a chamber at the front of the ship. After the [[Assault on Yavin 4]] was lost, she perished when the ''Knight Hammer'' disintegrated inside the gas giant [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]].
